responsibility: This file is the implementation core for GCC internal functions, the call-like GIMPLE operations synthesized by the compiler itself rather than exposed as user-callable builtins. It initializes the internal-function name/flag/fnspec tables from internal-fn.def, maps direct internal functions to optabs and target support checks, classifies special forms such as loads/stores/gathers/scatters and len-bias behavior, and expands internal-function calls into RTL through either generic expanders or target instruction patterns. It is the main lowering and capability-dispatch layer for IFN_* operations used by vectorization, sanitizers, OpenACC/OpenMP, atomics, coroutines, and other middle-end features.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/internal-fn.def, which enumerates IFN entries declaratively, and gcc/internal-fn.h, which declares the public API, this .cc file materializes the generated tables and implements lookup, support checks, classification, and RTL expansion behavior for internal functions.
